Game Overview

Paco Paco puts players into a arcade experience centered on guide the hungry sphere Paco Paco through twisting 3D mazes as it devours pellets while dodging clever ghosts. With unpredictable patterns haunting every corner, your quick reflexes and clever timing will unlock new levels with increasing difficulty. Each step brings thrilling urgency—can you escape the maze unscathed?
